tagline: Tomorrow's German power prices, forecast every morning
brief: A public dashboard that forecasts German day-ahead electricity prices before the auction closes and publishes an honest track record.
criteria: Distinct from lightning bolts and plugs, recognisable at 16 px, works in one colour on white, black and blue.

concepts.name: Step D
concepts.idea: A D split by one stepped line, the shape of an hourly price.
rationale: Says the name and the data at once
Avoids the category's bolts and plugs
A simplified cut keeps it clear at favicon size

recommendation: Step D is the selected direction.
next_steps: Run a trademark search before commercial use
